Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You hold the damaged fitting between your fingers. The metal warms and softens just enough for you to bend it back toward its proper shape.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Knowledge
Time
One minute per attempt.
Target / range / shape
An accessible ordinary metal item; one minute.
Duration
Information and earned progress persist for the stated task; completed changes remain until circumstances alter them.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic

Warm and bend a small damaged fitting, fastener or edge with your fingers. You do not create valuables or open an intact lock.

Weak
1 repair progress toward a DA-declared target.
Standard
2 repair progress.
Strong
3 repair progress; leave no visible rough edge.
